<div class="facts"><div class="fact"><small>Error ID</small><b>ST-APP-001</b></div><div class="fact"><small>Area</small><b>Dashboards, rules and reports</b></div><div class="fact wide"><small>Where you see it</small><b>Dashboard widget</b></div></div>

<div class="msg"><small>Message</small><span>No data to display</span></div>

## Why it happens

- The widget's data key does not match the key the device sends (keys are case-sensitive).
- The time window holds no values, for example the dashboard shows the last hour and the device sent nothing in that hour, or its timestamps are in seconds ([ST-DEV-004](/docs/troubleshooting/errors/st-dev-004/)).
- The alias resolves to no entity, or to another device than you expect.
- The user is a customer user who cannot see the device.

## Fix it

1. Open the device's **Latest telemetry** tab and compare the key names with the widget's data keys.
2. Widen the dashboard's time window.
3. In edit mode, open the widget's data source and check which entity the alias resolves to.
4. For customer users, check that the device is assigned to their customer or shared with their user group.

## Check that it worked

The widget shows values.
